mapper.insert: WITH inserted_launch AS ( INSERT INTO docs_viewer_launch ( correlation_id, viewer_provider, object_type, object_id, acl_object_type, acl_object_id, file_no, request_no, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, distribution_type, drawing_no, org_file_nm, revision, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{correlationId}, #{viewerProvider}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{aclObjectType}, #{aclObjectId}, #{fileNo}, NULLIF(#{requestNo}, ''), #{actorUserCd}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserNm}, NULLIF(#{distributionType}, ''), NULLIF(#{drawingNo}, ''), #{orgFileNm}, NULLIF(#{revision}, ''), CAST(#{expiresAt} AS timestamp with time zone) ) RETURNING correlation_id, distribution_type, drawing_no, object_id, org_file_nm, revision, file_no, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm ) INSERT INTO docs_history ( distribution_type, drawing_no, object_id, org_file_nm, revision, file_no, user_id, insert_date, user_nm, log_type, source_system_cd, source_event_id, source_correlation_id ) SELECT distribution_type, drawing_no, object_id, org_file_nm, revision, file_no, actor_user_id, clock_timestamp(), actor_user_nm, 'VIEWING', 'TDMS', CAST(correlation_id AS uuid), correlation_id FROM inserted_launch
mapper.select: SELECT correlation_id, viewer_provider, object_type, object_id, acl_object_type, acl_object_id, file_no, request_no, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, distribution_type, drawing_no, org_file_nm, revision, expires_at::text AS expires_at, TO_CHAR(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS created_at FROM docs_viewer_launch WHERE correlation_id = #{value}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM docs_viewer_launch WHERE expires_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - (CAST(#{value} AS integer) * INTERVAL '1 day')
DELETE FROM docs_viewer_callback_nonce WHERE created_at < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '1 day'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_viewer_callback_nonce (client_id, nonce) VALUES (#{clientId}, CAST(#{nonce} AS uuid)) ON CONFLICT (client_id, nonce) DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE docs_viewer_launch SET viewed_at = COALESCE( viewed_at, CAST(#{occurredAt} AS timestamp with time zone)) WHERE correlation_id = #{correlationId}
